name: Patch Notes — 2026-07-28
description: Official Discord patch covering upgrade VFX, tutorial changes, balance, account-bound systems, fixes, and performance work.
highlights: Upgrade VFX added for +8, +9, +10 equipment
Death animations added for NPCs and Goblins without ragdoll
Tutorial added targeting and spell-casting steps
Scrap Metal quest requirement reduced from 5 to 3
Chicken Pet bonus granted after Tutorial Ch1 P3 with an equip tutorial step
Aurora Wave mana cost per projectile increased 1.5x
Race Reroll odds normalized to 33.33% per race
Item drops no longer use physics
Dewdrop optimized with 4M triangles removed

name: Combat System Update
description: Official combat rules announcement for a subsequent patch.
notes: A small-update post later changed the planned attack cone from ±20° to ±45° before the patch was applied.
source: Official Discord big-updates tab + supplied combat-system infographic

name: Combat Attack Cone Revision
description: Planned attack cone widened from ±20° to ±45° for the next combat patch.

name: Patch Notes — 2026-07-30
description: Chapter 2 release plus skill, balance, quality-of-life, fix, and anti-cheat changes.
highlights: Chapter 2 released
Every item now displays whether it is bound, tradeable, or free
Aurora Wave reworked
Blade Circuit damage and slash count increased
Timber Charge damage increased and gained a 1-second stun against non-demihumans
Bash stun and slow increased
Heal now scales with Magic ATK
Mana Shield blocks crowd control except Cripple
Junk King HP increased from 35,000 to 1,050,000
Tin Tortoise HP increased from 37,500 to 525,000
Junk King and Tin Tortoise accessory drops about 25% more common
Spirit Stones about 2.5x more common from Junk King and Tin Tortoise
Spirit Stone effects can trigger every 1 second instead of every 3 seconds
World loot unlocks after Working the Land
Build Mode placement grid added

name: Patch Notes — 2026-08-03
description: AI, bug-fix, Premium Pass, elemental-system, headgear, and build-mode update.
highlights: Stuck monsters return to spawn after 2 seconds and remain invulnerable until reset
New Enchanter skill: Aqua Bloom (Water Element Magic)
Premium Pass added
New decoration recipe: Door
Monsters now have elemental attributes
Headgear added to Codex
Build Mode invalid placement overlay added
Fortune Clover, Bone Bite, Tinker's Goggles, and Plague Mask added

name: Patch Notes — v1.0.4
description: Collision, ladder, Greenhouse, and invalid-target mana-cost fixes.
highlights: Fixed collision issues that could trap players during repeated Auto Attack
Baby Phase players can climb ladders
Fixed various Greenhouse bugs
Casting without a valid target now consumes 50% of normal mana cost

name: Patch Notes — v1.0.5
description: Aqua Bloom, Combat Mode, and slippery-pole changes.
highlights: Fixed Aqua Bloom glitch
Combat Mode now triggers when dealing or receiving damage
Some poles are now slippery

name: Patch Notes — v1.1.6
description: Introduced Lycaros, Identify, regeneration changes, new skills, and other combat/world updates.
highlights: Lycaros added as a Weekly World Boss
Magnifying Glass introduced for Identify
HP/MP regeneration formula updated
In-combat regen is 50%, out-of-combat 100%, sitting 150%
Body Slam added for Defender / Earth
Tailwind added for Enchanter / Wind
Blade Rush added for Warrior / Neutral
Doombell added for Cleric / Fire
Whirlwind now scales with DEF and scaling increased from 100% to 400%
Dewdrop Ore Nodes increased from 20 to 35

name: Patch Notes — v1.1.7
description: Lycaros schedule, new skills, Identify reminder, and Part-Time Jobs.
highlights: Lycaros schedule listed as Saturday 16:00 and 04:00 GMT+7
Part-Time Jobs added for Breda, Eren, Neria, Leaf, Arlette, and Hogan

name: Patch Notes — v1.1.8
description: Lycaros/Forge fixes, player-interaction change, Timber Charge change, extra quick slots, and graphics settings.
highlights: Player interaction can only be triggered while sheathed
Timber Charge grants CC immunity while active, with queued CC continuing afterward except Timber Charge vs Timber Charge
Additional Quick Slots unlock after clearing Chapter 2
Skill VFX Filter added with Self, Party, and Everyone options
World Motion graphics toggle added

name: Patch Notes — v1.1.9
description: Dual Wield element, slider UI, SFX slider, and Part-Time Job fixes.
highlights: Fixed Dual Wield elemental effects
Fixed slider UI on PC and Mobile
Fixed SFX volume slider
Fixed skill-spam issue during Part-Time Jobs

name: Patch Notes — v1.1.10
description: Magnifying Glass monster drops, Claw Machine improvements, and Server Hop filters.
highlights: Junk King and Tin Tortoise can drop Magnifying Glass
Claw Machine stuck protection guarantees 1 Goblin Coin when no reward is received
Claw Machine displays reward probabilities
Claw Machine can be restocked
Server Hop filters added for All, Friends, and server-name search

name: Patch Notes — v1.1.12
description: Combat, pet, title, collision, and item-tradability improvements.
highlights: Only one title can be equipped at a time
Fixed fling-related false bans
Auto Jump disabled
All attacks now trigger Combat Mode
Fortune Clover and Bone Bite are tradable
Fixed Resurrect target selection
Pet pathfinding improved
Pet collision disabled
Cart collision disabled
notes: Discord displayed only the time because the post was made on the same local date the user supplied it; date normalized to 2026-08-18 using the user's timezone.

name: Patch Notes — v1.2.13
description: Guilds, Lycaros rewards, Claw Machine updates, Damage Up cap changes, and network improvements.
highlights: Guild System opened through Rendall; creation costs 499 Robux
Guild capacity starts at 15 members and can be upgraded to 30
Arcane Defense is available every Friday and must be started by the Guild Leader
Lycaros' Event Calendar schedule is displayed in the player's local time
Qualified Lycaros fighters receive 2 Magnifying Glass, 3 Goblin Coin, 3,500 Tria, and 300 Guild EXP
Lycaros base Prize Pool increased from 6 to 10
Top damage contributors receive additional Magnifying Glass: first 5, second 3, third 2; randomly distributed among party members
Magnifying Glass added to the Claw Machine prize pool
Maximum Damage Up increased from 100% to 120%
Reduced unnecessary network data transmission to improve network performance and data usage
source: Official Discord big-update announcement by Swaroff [PRTL], 2026-08-20
